description:
FILED AND FIXED s526w2 (Opus, resumed s528 2026-10-25), from the Log-Log4perl-1.58 board census (t/040Filter.t printed no TAP: Log::Log4perl::Config builds its filter table with `$filter_names{@$path[0]}++` and then died "Filter class '' doesn't exist").  PRE-EXISTING (main 31cd8c02).

    my @a = ("p","q"); my %h; $h{@a[1]} = 1; $h{@a[0]}++; print join(",", sort keys %h), "\n";
    sub ctx { wantarray ? "L" : "S" } my %c = (S => "s", L => "l"); print $c{ctx()}, "\n";
  perl 5.40.3: p,q / s        PCL (31cd8c02): ARRAY(0x4),ARRAY(0x5) / l
  (a READ in a scalar slot was already right: `my $z = $g{@a[1]}` emitted (p-list-scalar (p-aslice ...)); in a list slot -- `print $g{@a[1]}`, `@l = ($g{@a[0]})` -- it printed nothing.)

perl: the subscript of an element access is ONE scalar expression (scalar context, whatever context the element is in).

=== DONE (s526w2) ===
Pl/PExpr.pm child_context: child 1 (the subscript) of a_acc / h_acc / a_ref_acc / h_ref_acc is SCALAR_CTX, beside the existing child-0 rule for the reference operand; the list slice (`list_ctx_subscript`) answers first, slices are slice_*_acc nodes, a multi-key `$h{$x,$y}` is a `join $;` node with its own children.  Probes scratch/s526w2/pslk.pl pslk2.pl pslk3.pl = perl.  Log-Log4perl t/040Filter.t: no TAP -> 36/36.  Guard Pl/t/misc-fixes-01.t row 142 (inverse-verified: fails on a 31cd8c02 extraction).

RESIDUE (NOT fixed, same family, a different emission site): a bare ARRAY variable as the key, `$h{@a}` / `$a[@a]` in code, still passes the array itself -- `(p-gethash %h @a)` -- where perl keys on the COUNT ("2"); the generator does not wrap an array variable by its node context there.  And the interpolated "$h{@a}" likewise.  Probe pslk4.pl: perl `two|two`, PCL `|`.
subject: SILENT WRONG: the subscript of a single-element access ($h{K}, $a[K], $r->{K}, $r->[K]) inherited the element's context -- a one-element slice key (`$f{@$path[0]}++`) in an lvalue or a list slot keyed on "ARRAY(0x...)", a wantarray-aware key call ran in LIST context
